integrity.computation: Reproducible standard-library exact enumerations and numerical spot checks in verify.py supplement the analytical proof.
integrity.proof_basis: Direct finite parent-choice calculation and dominated triangular Riemann-sum argument; no stochastic distributional convergence inferred from expectations.
integrity.provenance: No independent mathematical validation or external proof certification is claimed.

scientific_limitations: Expected common labelled terminal-sibling counts and mismatched-parent counts only, not a distribution, concentration theorem, or statistical testing threshold.
The coupling requires a shared birth labelling and independent stepwise shared-versus-independent parent choices; it is not an unlabeled-tree theorem.
The source date is the documented first online publication of a classical single-tree reference; the correlated model itself has a later publicly dated source.
Historical-priority comparison was broad but not exhaustive; the 2026 correlated-tree preprint and a 2013 motif paper could not both be inspected in complete original full text in this pass.
title: Common terminal-sibling persistence in correlated recursive trees
